title: 第 2 章 任务，扇男主一巴掌
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“8星修为是什么意思，这里不是修仙界吗？”昭杺柠疑惑。

【宿主，这里是游戏修仙，重点是游戏再是修仙，修为等级依靠星级划分，从1星到最高12星】

系统解释完，着急提醒：【宿主，请先前往你的任务目标身边】

昭杺柠顺着系统的提醒转头看去。

果然在一个挂着“欢迎100岁以下小朋友前来测试灵根天赋”的横幅下，看见一个身穿青蓝锦袍的俊逸男子。

钟离珟一身青蓝锦袍，单马尾高高竖在脑后，怀里还抱着一柄银灰长剑。

那双桃花眼天生带笑，随意从广场扫过，却在看见昭杺柠时突然顿住。

昭杺柠手里捏着属于钟离珟的画像，抬眸间正巧跟钟离珟对视。

想到这个人不光是自己牵红线绑定的保镖，还是自己复活的任务目标，昭杺柠扬唇对他友好一笑。

看见昭杺柠的笑容，钟离珟目光落在昭杺柠手腕，审视的眼神一番打量，果然看见昭杺柠跟自己之间，那根链接两人的天道姻缘红线。

钟离珟眉梢一扬，心道：这就是……天道姻缘给他绑定的未婚妻？

而系统这边，也在提醒昭杺柠。

【宿主，确认钟离珟的位置，你的任务目标是他】

“我知道我知道，穿越之前不是做了连线小游戏吗，什么天才剑修魔尊同时追我，我可是选择全都要的。”

昭杺柠信心满满的声音，跟系统同时响起：

“所以我的任务是攻略钟离珟？”

【你的任务是将钟离珟打一顿】

“什么？！系统，你没搞错吧？”

【宿主，你没搞错吧？】

【宿主，请你好好核对任务，你需要主动挑衅钟离珟，并激怒他，让他追杀你，你再成功逃脱，就可以获得积分奖励】

“追杀我？我是活够了吗，我一个刚穿越的修仙菜鸟，让天才剑修追杀我？”昭杺柠震惊：“我脑子有病还是你脑子有病。”

又被讨伐型宿主友善问候了的系统感到很不舒服。

它想了半天，想到一个能让昭杺柠同样不舒服的办法。

系统幸灾乐祸开口：

【宿主，被钟离珟追杀，是你自己的选择哦】

【当时，痴情剑尊、霸道妖王、邪魅魔尊、温柔仙君、病娇鲛人、白切黑龙族少主，你可是选择了全部。】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"What does 8-star cultivation mean? Isn't this the world of immortal cultivation?" Zhao Hao Ning was confused.

[Host, this is a game of cultivating immortals. The focus is on games and then cultivating immortals. The cultivation levels are divided by stars, from 1 star to the highest 12 stars]

After the system finished explaining, it urgently reminded: [Host, please go to your mission target first]

Zhao Hao Ning turned around following the system's reminder.

Sure enough, under a banner that read "Children under 100 years old are welcome to come and test their spiritual talent", I saw a handsome man wearing a blue brocade robe.

Zhong Lizui was dressed in a blue brocade robe, with a single ponytail standing high on the back of his head, and holding a silver-gray sword in his arms.

Those peach blossom eyes were naturally smiling, and they swept across the square casually, but suddenly stopped when they saw Zhao Hao Ning.

Zhao Haining held a portrait belonging to Zhong Lizui in her hand, and when she raised her eyes, she happened to look at Zhong Lizui.

Thinking that this person was not only the bodyguard she bound with a red thread, but also the target of her resurrection mission, Zhao Hao Ning raised her lips and gave him a friendly smile.

Seeing Zhao Hao Ning's smile, Zhongli Sui's eyes fell on Zhao Hao Ning's wrist. He looked at Zhao Hao Ning's wrist carefully, and sure enough, he saw the red thread of heavenly marriage between Zhao Hao Ning and himself.

Zhongli Sui raised his eyebrows and thought to himself: This is... the fiancée bound to him by heaven's destiny?

The system was also reminding Zhao Hao Ning.

[Host, confirm the location of Zhongli Sui, your mission target is him]

"I know, I know. Didn't I play a connecting game before traveling through time? I chose to have all the genius sword cultivators and demon lords chasing me at the same time."

Zhao Hao Ning's confident voice sounded simultaneously with the system:

"So my mission is to capture Zhongli Sui?"

[Your mission is to beat up Zhongli Sui]

"What?! System, are you making a mistake?"

[Host, are you right?】

[Host, please check the mission carefully. You need to actively provoke Zhongli Sui and provoke him to let him chase you. If you successfully escape, you will get points as rewards]

"Chasing me? Have I lived enough? I am a rookie cultivator who has just traveled through time, and let a genius sword cultivator chase me?" Zhao Hao Ning was shocked: "Am I sick in the brain or are you?"

The system felt very uncomfortable after being greeted friendly by the subjugating host again.

It thought for a long time and came up with a way to make Zhao Hao Ning equally uncomfortable.

The system gloated and said:

[Host, being chased by Zhongli Sui is your own choice]

[At that time, you chose them all, the infatuated Sword Lord, the domineering Demon King, the evil Demon Lord, the gentle Immortal Lord, the sickly Mermaid, and the young master of the Black Dragon Tribe.】
